title: Add unit metadata while retaining a legacy input path
description: A fictional supplier proposes adding a unit field to a new format while the consumer continues to accept old numeric-only files. The supplier reports that its own export tests pass.
decision_requested: Approve, conditionally accept, or reject the interface change for a planned integration exercise; identify the minimum evidence and owner for each condition.
constraints: The complete legacy data provenance is not supplied.
Do not infer units from numerical magnitude alone.
No flight acceptance decision is requested.
